subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “The seed in the refrigerator did not grow at all.”?
options: The teacher asked Jenny to sing along.
The teacher asked, "Does this mean the cold seed is dead"
At the end of the week, the teacher asked what they had learned.
The teacher asked quietly if everything was all right.

optionRationales.reason: 本文沒有陳述「The teacher asked Jenny to sing along.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文可直接核對「The seed in the refrigerator did not grow at all. The teacher asked, 'Does this mean the cold seed is dead'」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「At the end of the week, the teacher asked what they had learned.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
本文沒有陳述「The teacher asked quietly if everything was all right.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「The seed in the refrigerator did not grow at all. The teacher asked, 'Does this mean the cold seed is dead'」，答案為「The teacher asked, 'Does this mean the cold seed is dead'」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「The teacher asked, 'Does this mean the cold seed is dead'」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
